title: Automattic confirms Mullenweg has returned as CEO after attempted ouster by board | TechCrunch
summary: Automattic confirmed Mullenweg’s removal to TechCrunch on Wednesday, saying that Mullenweg was “currently on leave” and that Automattic’s Chief Financial Officer, Mark Davies, would lead as interim CEO with “full confidence” of the board.
